text: Timer can't go to background? Maybe good for a quick cleaning, or meditation. But 14 hours of intermitten fasting and I can't send a timer to background. (with HabbitNow, I can) And ads in free version. Okay, I understand. (But no ads in HabitNow) so, for me, loosing 2 stars. Anyway, the app looks good, nice work, keep going, and nice to help people change their lives.
author: Mese Habbal
developer_reply: Hi. If you need to keep the timer running in the background, please ensure that app background optimization and power-saving mode are disabled on your phone, and keep the phone fully charged. In addition, ads help us provide free services to more users. We'll consider optimizing ad displays to minimize interruptions. Thanks for your understanding.
